evidence: Implements manual rebroadcasting logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and adds the rebroadcastwallettx RPC in src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp.
rationale: Adds a direct RPC and GUI mechanism to manually rebroadcast unconfirmed wallet transactions that failed to propagate or dropped from mempools. As noted in the description, users currently face the friction of having to manually extract transaction hex and invoke sendrawtransaction.
